notes: לָכֵן is one fused unit headed on כֵּן, the morpheme carrying the content (rules 23, 30).

The oath's אִם carries both the subordination the ASV writes as that and the negation it writes as not: no other morpheme in the clause licenses either word, so both belong to its one discontinuous unit, headed on the negation. The competing reading (that added under rule 55) is named in that unit's note.
The inner rectum עֵלִי is recast as an English possessive, so the construct בֵּית keeps its own word and the outer chain's of (rules 19, 29).
The second בְ over the coordinated member is unrepresented, the ASV writing no second preposition (rule 40).
